intent: Order confirmation: "Purchase Complete" with a tick, then Wireless Headphones Pro with its picture https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505740420928-5e560c06d30e?w=100&h=100&fit=crop and the price 199.99 USD. Below a line, "Ready for pickup today" and "Sold by: TechStore Official", and a "Track order" button.
reference_express:
surface("gallery-purchase-complete", sendDataModel=true)
$/deliveryDate = "Ready for pickup today"
$/price = 199.99
$/productImage = "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505740420928-5e560c06d30e?w=100&h=100&fit=crop"
$/productName = "Wireless Headphones Pro"
$/seller = "TechStore Official"
root = Card(main_column)
main_column = Column([success_icon, title, product_row, divider, details_col, view_btn], _, "center")
success_icon = Icon("check")
title = Text("## Purchase Complete")
product_row = Row([product_image, product_info], _, "center")
product_image = Image($/productImage, _, "cover")
product_info = Column([product_name, product_price])
product_name = Text($/productName)
product_price = Text(formatCurrency($/price, "USD"), "body")
divider = Divider()
details_col = Column([delivery_row, seller_row])
delivery_row = Row([delivery_icon, delivery_text], _, "center")
delivery_icon = Icon("arrowForward")
delivery_text = Text($/deliveryDate, "body")
seller_row = Row([seller_label, seller_name])
seller_label = Text("Sold by:", "caption")
seller_name = Text($/seller, "body")
view_btn_text = Text("Track order")
view_btn = Button(view_btn_text, _, Event("track_order", {}))

intent: A "Stock on hand" card listing Flour (2), Sugar (1), each line as the name, ": ", then the quantity.
reference_express:
surface("gallery-child-list-template", sendDataModel=true)
$/items = [{name: "Flour", quantity: 2}, {name: "Sugar", quantity: 1}]
root = Card(main_column)
main_column = Column([title_text, item_list], _, "stretch")
title_text = Text("### Stock on hand")
item_list = List(_template($/items, item_row))
item_row = Row([item_name, qty_label, item_qty])
item_name = Text($name)
qty_label = Text(": ")
item_qty = Text($quantity)

intent: Corner Café receipt with Cold Brew, Large, 5.5 | Banana Bread, Toasted, 3.9 | Espresso, Double, 3.2; subtotal 12.6, tax 1.26, total 13.86 AUD. Purchase and Add to cart buttons at the end.
reference_express:
surface("gallery-coffee-order", sendDataModel=true)
$/items = [{name: "Cold Brew", size: "Large", price: 5.5}, {name: "Banana Bread", size: "Toasted", price: 3.9}, {name: "Espresso", size: "Double", price: 3.2}]
$/storeName = "Corner Café"
$/subtotal = 12.6
$/tax = 1.26
$/total = 13.86
root = Card(main_column)
main_column = Column([header, items_list, divider, totals, actions])
header = Row([coffee_icon, store_name], _, "center")
coffee_icon = Icon("shoppingCart")
store_name = Text($/storeName)
items_list = Column(_template($/items, order_item_template))
order_item_template = Row([item_details, item_price], "spaceBetween", "start")
item_details = Column([item_name, item_size])
item_name = Text($name, "body")
item_size = Text($size, "caption")
item_price = Text(formatCurrency($price, "AUD"), "body")
divider = Divider()
totals = Column([subtotal_row, tax_row, total_row])
subtotal_row = Row([subtotal_label, subtotal_value], "spaceBetween")
subtotal_label = Text("Subtotal", "caption")
subtotal_value = Text(formatCurrency($/subtotal, "AUD"), "body")
tax_row = Row([tax_label, tax_value], "spaceBetween")
tax_label = Text("Tax", "caption")
tax_value = Text(formatCurrency($/tax, "AUD"), "body")
total_row = Row([total_label, total_value], "spaceBetween")
total_label = Text("#### Total")
total_value = Text(formatCurrency($/total, "AUD"))
actions = Row([purchase_btn, add_btn])
purchase_btn_text = Text("Purchase")
purchase_btn = Button(purchase_btn_text, _, Event("purchase", {}))
add_btn_text = Text("Add to cart")
add_btn = Button(add_btn_text, _, Event("add_to_cart", {}))
